summary: Air-date lane (G53) only; no anchors. Stored ep 47 (2011-12-08) is a digit transposition of the real 2011-12-18. Beelzebub aired weekly Sunday 07:00 on ytv/NTV; バブ45=12/4, バブ46=12/11, バブ47=12/18, バブ48=12/25, and 2012-01-08 for バブ49 — all three sources agree and the neighbours stored in the DB are already correct. One repair, no true deviation.

repairs.why: ja-WP 各話リスト gives バブ47「お待たせしました」= 2011年12月18日; en-WP gives December 18, 2011; syoboi Count 47 = 2011-12-18 07:00. Stored 12-08 is a transposition of 12-18. Neighbours 46 (12-11) and 48 (12-25) are already correct, so the row itself is the defect.

structure.notes: Our row numbers map 1:1 onto the ja-WP バブNN numbering (60 rows = バブ1–バブ60 incl. the two split 53-A/B and 55-A/B counts as stored). No numbering conversion needed.
